title: Lab 2B — EventBridge schedule
topic: EventBridge schedule rules, ECS RunTask target, IAM trust for events.amazonaws.com, CloudWatch FailedInvocations
format: 15 timed scenario questions (~24 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-12-eventbridge-schedule.md and night-12-lab-eventbridge-schedule.sh. Answer without peeking at night-12-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×4 B×4 C×4 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: A monthly one-shot Fargate batch job runs in private subnets with no HTTP endpoint. Manual ecs:RunTask already works. What is the best way to trigger it on the 1st of each month without an always-on EC2 instance?

options.A: Application Load Balancer health check that invokes ecs:RunTask
options.B: EventBridge schedule rule with an ECS RunTask target and cron
options.C: NAT Gateway scheduled maintenance window that starts the Fargate task
options.D: CloudFront origin request trigger writing to the S3 output bucket

questions.question: You create an EventBridge rule targeting ecs:RunTask. The rule shows FailedInvocations in CloudWatch. The task definition and cluster names are correct. What is the most common IAM fix?

options.A: Attach AmazonEC2FullAccess to the default event bus IAM resource
options.B: Grant the rule permission to assume the task role directly only
options.C: Target IAM role trusted by events.amazonaws.com with RunTask + PassRole
options.D: Move the schedule rule to a custom event bus named ecs.amazonaws.com

questions.question: An EventBridge ECS target sets AssignPublicIp to DISABLED and passes private subnet IDs. Why must the scheduled target include the same networkConfiguration as a manual RunTask?

options.A: Scheduled RunTask still creates an awsvpc ENI — needs subnets and SG
options.B: EventBridge always launches tasks in the default VPC public subnet
options.C: AssignPublicIp ENABLED is required only for EventBridge-started tasks
options.D: The cron schedule expression must match the private subnet CIDR block

questions.question: Which schedule expression runs a batch pipeline at 06:00 UTC on the first day of every month?

options.A: cron(0 6 1 * ? *) — 06:00 UTC on day 1 each month
options.B: rate(1 month) — EventBridge monthly rate expression
options.C: cron(6 0 1 * * *) — hour and minute fields swapped from UTC
options.D: cron(0 0 ? * 1 *) — every Monday at midnight UTC only

questions.question: CI already has ecs:RunTask and iam:PassRole for a Fargate task. After adding EventBridge, why can the rule not reuse the CI IAM user credentials?

options.A: EventBridge assumes a dedicated target role — not CI long-lived keys
options.B: Fargate rejects any task started by a human IAM user principal
options.C: PassRole is valid only when the target type is Lambda, not ECS
options.D: CI credentials always expire every 15 minutes and cannot be reused

questions.question: An exam question describes decoupling microservices so a spike in orders does not overwhelm the inventory API. The inventory team wants to process at their own pace with at-least-once delivery. Which service fits better than an EventBridge schedule rule?

options.A: EventBridge cron expression targeting ECS RunTask monthly
options.B: AWS Config conformance pack evaluating inventory API drift
options.C: Amazon SQS standard queue between producer and consumer
options.D: VPC peering between the orders VPC and inventory VPC only

questions.question: A CloudWatch alarm watches FailedInvocations on an EventBridge rule and fires. The Invocations metric is zero. What most likely happened?

options.A: The container exited with code 1 after the task started successfully
options.B: S3 rejected the upload after the Fargate task began writing output
options.C: NAT Gateway billing threshold was exceeded for the private subnet path
options.D: EventBridge could not invoke the ECS target (IAM or invalid config)

questions.question: What is the trust policy principal for the IAM role used by an EventBridge rule that calls ecs:RunTask?

options.A: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com — same trust as the Fargate task role
options.B: events.amazonaws.com — EventBridge assumes the target role
options.C: lambda.amazonaws.com — required for any EventBridge rule target
options.D: scheduler.amazonaws.com only — classic rules cannot assume roles

questions.question: You need a one-time reminder to run a migration at 2026-07-01 03:00 UTC with flexible delivery within a 15-minute window and automatic retries. Which option is most purpose-built?

options.A: Classic EventBridge rate(1 day) rule repeating every day forever
options.B: CloudWatch Logs subscription filter matching migration log lines
options.C: EC2 instance user-data cron job waiting for that exact UTC timestamp
options.D: Amazon EventBridge Scheduler with a flexible time window schedule

questions.question: A batch ETL pipeline is not a long-running web service. Which statement about load balancers is correct for scheduled ECS RunTask?

options.A: An internal ALB is required so EventBridge can health-check the task
options.B: Network Load Balancer must front Fargate for EventBridge RunTask triggers
options.C: No load balancer is needed — RunTask starts the batch task directly
options.D: Gateway Load Balancer inspects scheduled ECS Fargate tasks by default

questions.question: An EventBridge target role scopes ecs:RunTask with a Condition on ecs:cluster. Why scope RunTask to one cluster ARN?

options.A: Fargate tasks can only run in one ECS cluster per AWS account ever
options.B: Least privilege — the role should not start tasks on other clusters
options.C: EventBridge ignores RunTask unless cluster name equals the rule name
options.D: PassRole requires the cluster name string to match the IAM role name

questions.question: A rule on the default event bus matches {"source":["aws.ecs"],"detail-type":["ECS Task State Change"]}. What type of rule is this compared to a monthly cron pipeline rule?

options.A: Schedule expression rule — identical to cron(0 6 1 * ? *) monthly
options.B: API destination rule — calls an external HTTPS webhook endpoint
options.C: Cross-Region replication rule copying events onto another event bus
options.D: Event pattern rule — reacts to AWS service events, not a timetable

questions.question: For a quick validation you temporarily set an EventBridge rule to rate(1 minute), then restore cron(0 6 1 * ? *) after success. What cost should you expect compared to leaving rate(1 minute) enabled?

options.A: Identical — schedule expression does not affect Fargate run cost
options.B: Higher — cron rules incur per-invocation charges that rate rules skip
options.C: Lower — monthly cron runs the expensive Fargate task far less often
options.D: Zero in both cases — Fargate is free when EventBridge starts the task

questions.question: Which iam:PassRole condition key should appear when EventBridge passes an ECS execution role to ECS?

options.A: iam:PassedToService = ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com for ECS task roles
options.B: iam:PassedToService = events.amazonaws.com for the target role
options.C: iam:PassedToService = s3.amazonaws.com for pipeline output uploads
options.D: No condition is allowed — PassRole cannot be constrained by service

questions.question: You later add SQS so the pipeline publishes a completion message instead of chaining synchronously. How does that differ from EventBridge schedule → RunTask?

options.A: SQS replaces the need for ECS Fargate tasks in this architecture
options.B: EventBridge schedules the batch; SQS buffers producers and consumers
options.C: EventBridge cannot target ECS if an SQS queue exists in the account
options.D: SQS only works with API Gateway WebSocket APIs, not with batch jobs
